Two members are the 2004 Nature Neuroscience 'Attention alters appearance' (Carrasco, Ling & Read), DOI 10.1038/nn1194. But carrasco2019attention is a different publication: a 2019 book chapter in 'Blockheads!' (MIT Press), single author Carrasco, with a DIFFERENT DOI (10.7551/mitpress/9196.003.0006). It is a reprint in a distinct venue and should not be merged into the 2004 article.

carston2004truthconditional is the 2004 OUP book chapter 'Explicature and Semantics' in 'Semantics' (pp. 817-845) with the DOI. carston2000explicatur is a distinct earlier publication: the 2000 'UCL Working Papers in Linguistics' article (vol 12, pp. 1-44), no DOI. These are separate bibliographic entries (different year, venue, pages) and should not be merged.
